title: Fable 5.1: $0.25 Reads, $50 Rewrites
caption:
Fable 5.1 made my cache reads 4x cheaper and my diffs a lot longer.

Saw the $0.25 and switched everything over before reading the behavior notes. Then it started rewriting whole files for one-line changes.

The discount is real. It's just sitting in a different column than the regression.

You on 5.1 yet?
